comparison.objective: Remove an interrupted suture using forceps and a stitch cutter, then dispose of it.
comparison.physical_skill: Millimetre-scale lift, supported cutting, direction-controlled extraction, and two-tool coordination.
comparison.success_condition: Correct leg cut flush, stitch drawn toward wound without excess opening, deposited on gauze, tools returned; tissue damage fails.
comparison.reason: Both intentionally separate and recover a small element with two tools, but the mechanisms and abilities differ materially: supported slicing and compliant-thread extraction versus mandrel-transmitted impact fracture inside a threaded insert.
